messages:
arjun: Quick intake — bringing up 'redwood-lite-30b' (GGUF) on hosted + dedicated. Need recommendation for a fast default quant plan (int8 vs fp8) and a short calibration checklist. Goal: <=1.5x latency increase vs fp16 and <10% eval regen on our QA set. :eyes:

sophia: are we doing per-channel symmetric int8 or asymmetric? for transformer weights per-channel usually better.

mike: preference is per-channel int8 for linear weights, fp8 for attention if hardware supports. But fp8 runtimes are still flaky on some infra.

jess: can we get a quick cost vs quality estimate? rough numbers ok.

arjun: rough targets I had in mind:
- int8 (per-channel symmetric) => ~2.3x throughput, QA regen risk ~8-12%
- fp8 (block-fp8 variant) => ~1.8x throughput, QA regen ~4-6%
- hybrid (attention fp8 + mlp int8) => ~2.0x, regen ~5-8%
these are approximate, need calibration to tune.

quant-bot: Calib job template available:```
calib_config:
  dataset: redwood-qual-1k
  per_channel: true
  input_sample_frac: 0.02
  outlier_clip: 99.9
  optimizer: mse
```
use `--profile hybrid` to try attention-fp8 + linear-int8.

sophia: propose a 3-step plan:
1) Smoke qual run (100 prompts) w/ int8 per-channel + default outlier_clip 99.9 -> get regen deltas
2) Hybrid run (attention fp8, mlp int8) same 100 prompts -> compare failure modes
3) Full calibration (redwood-qual-1k) sweeping `outlier_clip` [99.0, 99.5, 99.9] and `input_sample_frac` [0.01, 0.02, 0.05], capture latency, peak memory, and regen.
Include isolated tests for long-context behavior (>=2k tokens).

mike: +1. add perf traces (nvtx) and token-level latency percentiles p50/p95/p99. Also collect kv-cache growth and mem fragmentation metrics on dedicated nodes.

jess: who owns the eval harness? I can run the smoke and hybrid runs today if someone drops the calibration config artifact.

arjun: @jess please run smoke + hybrid. @sophia can you prepare the full calib job and the eval dashboard slice? I'll draft the rollout gating thresholds.

sophia: will add those to the job: gating thresholds suggestion:
- QA regen <= 7% to consider int8 default on hosted (with quality monitor)
- QA regen <= 5% for hybrid default on Dedicated
- p95 latency < 1.5x fp16 baseline for both
- memory reduction >= 30% for int8 to justify cost wins
I’ll put these in the job metadata.

quant-bot: Created calib artifact: `calib/1872506789/redwood-lite-30b/v1` (link: https://ci.redwood.ai/calib/1872506789).

jess: running smoke now, will post logs when done.

(10m later)

jess: smoke results -> int8 per-channel: regen 9.3%, p95 latency 1.42x, memory -34%. hybrid: regen 5.1%, p95 1.3x, memory -29%. attaching short log:```
[smoke] int8_regen: 9.3
[smoke] hybrid_regen: 5.1
[perf] int8_p95: 1420ms
[perf] hybrid_p95: 1300ms
```

arjun: initial read: hybrid meets Dedicated gating, int8 borderline for hosted (regen >7). Thoughts on mitigations to push int8 regen down?

sophia: try increasing sample fraction and lowering outlier_clip to 99.5, also enable asymmetric quant for final layer norms — that sometimes helps logits.

mike: also try bias-correction post-quant for attention projection layers. Small API change in runtime but cheap and often reduces regen by ~1-2%.

jess: kicking off full calib sweep now (configs per sop). ETA ~2h, will collect p50/p95/p99 + regen heatmap.

arjun: perfect. After sweep, if int8 still >7% regen, we pick hybrid as default for Dedicated and consider keeping int8 as opt-in for hosted with a quality-monitor rollback (canary traffic).

sophia: noted. I'll prepare a short checklist for onboarding doc:
- run smoke (100 prompts) int8 + hybrid
- run full calib sweep with job artifact
- collect latency & mem traces
- run long-context stress tests (2k/4k tokens)
- run eval regression set (1k) + error analysis
- decide default profile per gating thresholds
- add canary rollout plan + automatic rollback rule

mike: small add — record model-conversion metadata (GGUF tags, quant tool version, RNG seed) in artifact for reproducibility.

arjun: agreed. folks, thanks — this is a solid fastpath. post results and we'll lock default for 1 week then watch the quality monitor. :thumbsup:
